name: soundcloud-like-ratio
description: Development tooling for the SoundCloud Like Ratio browser extension.

scripts.start:chrome: web-ext run --target chromium --start-url https://soundcloud.com --ignore-files AGENTS.md README.md package.json package-lock.json "scripts/**" "tests/**"
scripts.start:firefox: web-ext run --start-url https://soundcloud.com --ignore-files AGENTS.md README.md package.json package-lock.json "scripts/**" "tests/**"
